messages:
nina: quick sync - finalizing invite segmentation + language for May webinar. I want to lock subject lines and which CTA each persona sees.

cal: propose three persona buckets: startup, mid-market, enterprise. subject + CTA map below.

yasmin: drop them pls.

cal: startup -> Subject: "Cut inference costs 3x: live demo" CTA: "Try Redwood free"
mid-market -> Subject: "Scale LLM features with predictable latency" CTA: "See pricing & performance"
enterprise -> Subject: "SLA-backed inference: benchmarks & architecture" CTA: "Request an audit"

frank: routing rules ready. enterprise if company_size>250 OR domain in allowlist. mid-market 50-249. else startup. Also add hidden reg-field: primary_interest (benchmarks/ops/prompting) to auto-assign breakout rooms.

nina: good. small copy tweak: enterprise subject remove word SLA (too legal), use: "Enterprise inference: benchmarks & architecture"

cal: done. mailer-bot, schedule A/B for subject lines on 50% of traffic, track CTR, reg->qualified conversion.

mailer-bot: A/B campaign scheduled: 2026-04-22T08:00:00Z. Split: 50/50. Tracking tags: ab_subj_v1, ab_subj_v2.

yasmin: social copy note: for developer channels highlight KV cache + failover demo. For biz channels push outcomes + audit CTA.

nina: perfect. action items: cal - update reg form with hidden field (due EOD), frank - implement routing rules (due 48h), yasmin - final social variants (due 2026-04-23).

nina: thanks all, i'll post final invite copy in #marketing-drafts before send. :smile:
